per_step_one_job.task: stack_blocks_three / demo_clean, one job alone on one H20, policy server on the same GPU
per_step_one_job.note: take_action = physics 12, TOPP 9, setting joints and grippers 8, per-substep render sync and success check 3 ms. Inference includes the amortized first-call compilation.

per_job_fixed.note: Simulator import includes two nvidia-smi calls made while importing sapien (6.6 s). From the second job of a resident worker the fixed cost is 2-3 s.

per_episode_expert_s.note: Expert check (cuRobo planning + physics) per tried seed; replayed from a record in Faster-RoboTwin.

per_step_gpu_saturated.kind: measured (frame log on a quiet host; 5 jobs bitwise identical) and derived
per_step_gpu_saturated.note: measured_step_interval = 1000 / 9.76 steps/s; official_step = 1000 / 2.1637 steps/s (ladder.json). 5x pace = official_step / 5.
